newsitem.title: USA: Packaging Plus sees Q3 eps $0.07-$0.11-shr.
newsitem.headline: Packaging Plus sees Q3 eps $0.07-$0.11-shr.

text.p: Packaging Plus Services Inc expects to report third-quarter earnings of between $0.07 per share and $0.11 per share, compared with a loss of $0.04 per share, partly because of its acquisition Wednesday of U.S. Transportation Systems' Entertainment unit, Packaging Plus Chairman Richard Altomare told Reuters.
The company bought the unit Wednesday for $800,000 in Packaging Plus stock, valued at about $1 a share, he said.
The acquisition will add about $300,000 a year to Packaging Plus' earnings going forward, Altomare added, on revenue of about $3.3 million. The company's third-quarter ends in March.
The unit consists of six companies that provide New York theater, sports and special events ticket and concierge services, Packaging Plus said.
The company said it will incorporate the services into its 4,000 APAC stores and design an internet website for the facilitation of the services.
APAC is an on-line national trade association for the private postal industry.
